description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Ahri''' generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Essence Fragment'' whenever she kills a [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minion]] or [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]]. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] herself for 35 – 95 (based on level) (+ 20% AP).
description.text: Innate: Ahri generates a stack of Essence Fragment whenever she kills a minion or monster. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to heal herself for 35 – 95 (based on level) (+ 20% AP).

description2.raw: Additionally, whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion [[File:Damage rating.png|20px|link=Takedown|An icon representing the keyword Takedown]] [[:Takedown|takedown]] within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for 75 – 165 (based on level) (+ 30% AP).
description2.text: Additionally, whenever Ahri scores a champion takedown within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for 75 – 165 (based on level) (+ 30% AP).
